chunks: Ibn al-‘Ajamī had assigned one-third of his estate to al-Nāḥiyah and wrote this down. Before setting aside the third, he had given some wealth to his son Abī al-Miqdām, and no one had become aware of it. Then he wrote to him: “Where is the wealth that you set aside for Abī al-Miqdām?”

key_terms.أَبِي الْمِقْدَامِ: Abī al-Miqdām, the son mentioned in the report
key_terms.ثُلُثَهُ: one-third of his estate or property share
key_terms.لِلنَّاحِيَةِ: for al-Nāḥiyah, referring to the sacred authority addressed in the report
key_terms.مَالًا: a sum of wealth or property

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Ibn al-‘Ajamī’s allocation of his estate to al-Nāḥiyah and the hidden wealth given to Abī al-Miqdām?
ai.summary: This report relates that Ibn al-‘Ajamī dedicated one-third of his estate to al-Nāḥiyah while having privately transferred some wealth to his son Abī al-Miqdām beforehand. The reply asking about that concealed amount reflects knowledge of the hidden transaction and is presented within the context of the Imam’s authority and awareness.
